headline: Supreme Petrochem posts strong Q2 growth and declares interim dividend
hook: Profit nearly doubles on surging revenue
summary: Supreme Petrochem reported a 77.8% year-on-year rise in revenue to ₹1,956.7 crore for Q2 FY27. Profit after tax nearly doubled to ₹94.9 crore during the quarter. The company also declared a first interim dividend of ₹2.50 per share for FY27. October 30 has been set as the record date for this payout. Indian retail shareholders in the company will receive the dividend if they hold the stock by the record date.
whats_next: Record date on October 30 for interim dividend
why_it_matters: Interim payout and strong earnings boost shareholder returns
winners_losers: Supreme Petrochem shareholders gain / competitors neutral
